body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/33055

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/3434

Candidate parent PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3414 at exact commit `c5812a14220bf0d4ebe1cf98cd2c63b818c98aa8`

Independent review parent PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3433

## Summary

This consolidates the candidate's valid additive Rust `/server_info.kv_events` implementation and corrects the concrete remaining counterexample from independent review. Rust now validates that a bracketed TCP host is an actual IPv6 address before advertising it. Consequently `tcp://[not-ipv6]:5557` returns `kv_events: null`, matching Python, while valid bracketed IPv6 remains supported.

The candidate's typed `ServerArgs` plumbing, existing server-info allowlist/redaction boundary, malformed/disabled configuration handling, valid TCP/port/page-size checks, and synthetic secret-canary coverage are preserved. This does not implement KV-event publishing.

## Failing before

On the exact candidate implementation, after adding the regression without changing the parser:

```bash
PATH=/job/.cargo/bin:$PATH \
CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e4438b826eaf/cargo-target \
cargo test -p sglang-server bracketed_non_ipv6_host_is_not_advertisable \
  --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
```

Exited 101:

```text
left: Some(("[not-ipv6]", 5557))
right: None
```

Python's canonical `parse_advertisable_tcp("tcp://[not-ipv6]:5557")` independently returned `None`.

## Passing after

```bash
PATH=/job/.cargo/bin:$PATH \
CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e4438b826eaf/cargo-target \
cargo test -p sglang-server api_server::common::tests \
  --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
```

Result: 5 passed, including malformed bracketed host, valid IPv6, null fallbacks, allowlisting, and secret canaries.

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e4438b826eaf/venv/bin/python \
  -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_server_info.py
```

Result: 29 passed, 12 subtests passed.

A forced release rebuild from `/job/repo/rust` with Rust 1.92.0 succeeded, and the rebuilt extension was imported from `/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e4438b826eaf/rust-extension-cache-final/.../_server.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so`.

Full commands and claims are recorded in `reports/j-e4438b826eaf/result.json` and its evidence directory.

## Limitations

No GPU was used because this is CPU-only endpoint parsing and JSON metadata serialization; Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2 were left unchanged. The Rust serializer and rebuilt native extension were exercised, but a live model-backed Axum server was not launched. KV-event publishing remains out of scope.
